title: The Goat Ate It!
objectives_ko: 글자 G·H·I의 이름과 소리를 알고 말한다
G·H·I로 시작하는 단어 9개를 듣고 말하고 찾는다
사이트워드 it, my를 보고 읽는다 (1~2유닛의 I, see, a, the, is 복습)

story.title: The Goat Ate It!

panels.desc: A grassy corner of the Sound Garden with a wooden fence. A white goat with small horns and a little beard is chewing, and a glowing golden seed is just disappearing into its mouth — gulp! Bun gasps with both paws on her cheeks, Hedgie points at the goat in shock, Pip flutters above them with its beak open in surprise. Hidden in the picture: a brown acoustic guitar leaning against the fence, a wooden-handled hammer lying on a tool bench. Far away on a small hill in the background, Grumble sits with two acorn caps pressed over his ears like earmuffs, eyes squeezed shut; his tiny candle lantern beside him is almost dark, only a faint spark.
panels.ko: 염소가 씨앗을 꿀꺽! 모두 깜짝 놀라요. 언덕 위 그럼블은 도토리 껍질을 귀마개처럼 꼈어요.

panels.desc: Same garden corner. Hedgie kneels and holds out a gift box wrapped in red paper with a yellow ribbon toward the goat; the goat's eyes go wide with delight and the glowing seed pops back out of its mouth into the air. Beside them Pip is trying its very best to say a sound but only hiccups: it bounces up with puffed feathers, little hiccup puffs around its head. Bun laughs and cups her paws to shout. Hidden in the picture: a brown hen pecking by the fence, a tiny ladybug-like insect on Bun's green boot. Grumble does NOT appear.
panels.ko: 헤지가 선물을 주자 염소가 씨앗을 퉤! 뱉어요. 핍은 /g/ 소리를 내려다 딸꾹질만 해요.

panels.desc: A muddy puddle at the edge of the garden. A chubby purple-grey hippo lies happily in the mud with a glowing golden seed resting on top of its head. Bun stands on a stepping stone pointing at the hippo; Hedgie holds his nose; Pip hovers over the hippo, glowing. Behind them a new letter tree with goat-, gift- and guitar-shaped fruits has just sprouted. Hidden in the picture: a glass bottle of blue ink with a feather quill on a garden bench. In the back corner, Grumble has crept closer behind a bush: one acorn cap has fallen off his ear, and his lantern now shows a small steady flame.
panels.ko: 하마가 진흙탕에 누워 있어요. 머리 위에 씨앗이! 그럼블의 귀마개 하나가 떨어졌어요.

panels.desc: An icy corner of the garden with frost and a few snowflakes: a white igloo made of snow blocks, a glowing golden seed sitting on top of it. Bun and Hedgie stand before the igloo with arms raised in triumph; three new letter trees (G with goat, gift and guitar fruits; H with hen, hippo and hammer fruits; I with ink, igloo and insect fruits) stand behind them. Pip glows brightly. Right next to the igloo, Grumble has popped out of a dirt hole: both acorn caps have fallen to the ground, he presses one paw to his mouth, and his lantern now glows with a small warm light, noticeably brighter than before. Hidden in the picture: a tiny ladybug-like insect sitting on the top of the igloo, an ink bottle on the icy shelf.
panels.ko: 얼음 구석 이글루 위에 씨앗이 있어요. G·H·I 나무가 자랐어요. 그럼블의 귀마개가 다 떨어지고 등불이 조금 밝아졌어요.

story.synopsis_ko: 염소가 씨앗을 꿀꺽 삼켰어요! 헤지가 선물을 주자 염소가 씨앗을 뱉었어요. 하마 진흙탕과 이글루에서도 씨앗을 찾았어요. 그럼블은 도토리 귀마개를 꼈지만 소용없었어요.
story.so_far_ko: 연못에서 D·E·F 나무를 키우고, 물에 빠진 그럼블을 건져 주었어요.
story.goal_ko: 염소가 삼킨 씨앗을 되찾고 G·H·I 나무를 키워요.

videos.prompt: Gentle comic picture-book animation: the white goat chews, then gulps and the glowing seed vanishes into its mouth with a little sparkle; the rabbit and the hedgehog jump back in surprise; the baby bird flutters up. Camera still. Playful, child-friendly. No text.

Gentle picture-book animation: the hippo wiggles happily in the mud and a few mud drops splash, the golden seed on its head twinkles, then with a soft POP a small cheerful letter tree sprouts beside the puddle and grows quickly; the baby bird glows. Camera still. Child-friendly. No text.
